relationships.stella-vermillion: Lover and intended fiancee; he reassures her that he loves Vermillion because its people love and protect her.
relationships.sirius-vermillion: Prospective father-in-law who secretly orchestrates a national manhunt against him before reluctantly agreeing to a trial.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Prospective sister-in-law who sets the condition that Ikki help Vermillion win the war.
relationships.daniel-dandalion: Elite sword instructor who tests him at the castle wall and entrusts Stella to him after defeat.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Explains Ikki's Desperado awakening and asks him to protect Japan's future.

periods.summary: Ikki celebrates his Seven Stars victory in Osaka, then meets Tsukikage at the Bay Dome and learns that using a second Ittou Shura against Stella was a Desperado awakening. He accepts the need to keep the truth secret while rejecting Tsukikage's help until Tsukikage explains the future war he foresaw. During his trip to Vermillion, Ikki is attacked by citizens, soldiers, young C-rank knights, royal guards, and Daniel Dandalion because the nation wants to test the man who would take Stella. Instead of resenting them, he concludes that their hostility comes from love for Stella. He publicly asks Stella's family to test him and pledges to meet any demand, then accepts Lunaeyes's condition that he fight for Vermillion in the war against Quedolan.

key_events.summary: Fights Ascaride with Stella and learns he has entered the Desperado realm.
Hears Tsukikage's explanation of his anti-League plot and the future destruction of Tokyo.
Is hunted across Freyja Vorg by citizens and the army as a national test.
Breaks through the royal guard, defeats Dandalion, and reaches the castle.
Publicly pledges himself to Stella and accepts the war victory condition.
